$comment: Who Am I? cards. Hints run from vague to nearly giving it away, and are drip-fed one at a time at the cost of a turn. Aliases cover the names people actually type.

items.name: Cleopatra
hints: I lived a very long time ago.
I ruled a country along a famous river.
Rome was extremely interested in my kingdom.

items.name: Mahatma Gandhi
hints: I am known for what I refused to do.
I walked a very long way to the sea over a tax.
I am on every note in India.

items.name: Albert Einstein
hints: My hair is as famous as my work.
I rewrote what people thought about time.
There is an equation with my name on it.

items.name: Marie Curie
hints: I won more than one Nobel Prize.
I worked with things that glowed.
My notebooks are still too dangerous to handle.

items.name: Ada Lovelace
hints: My father was a famous poet.
I wrote about a machine that was never built.
Some call me the first programmer.

items.name: Isaac Newton
hints: There is a story about me and a tree.
I argued with Leibniz about who was first.
Forces are measured in my name.

items.name: Charles Darwin
hints: I took a very long boat trip.
Some islands changed my mind about everything.
I made a lot of people angry about finches.

items.name: Nikola Tesla
hints: I had a long argument about electricity.
A car company borrowed my name.
I preferred alternating current.

items.name: Frida Kahlo
hints: I painted myself more than anything else.
I am from Mexico.
My eyebrows are part of my signature.

items.name: Vincent van Gogh
hints: I sold almost nothing while alive.
I painted a very famous night sky.
I am missing part of an ear.

items.name: Pablo Picasso
hints: I put both eyes on the same side of a face.
I helped invent a whole movement.
I painted a town being bombed.

items.name: William Shakespeare
hints: I wrote a great deal about Danish princes.
People still argue about whether I existed.
I invented words you use every day.

items.name: Sherlock Holmes
hints: I am not real, but people write to me.
I have a doctor for a friend.
I live on a famous London street.

items.name: Hermione Granger
hints: I read more than my friends.
I went to a school with moving staircases.
I fixed my own teeth with magic.

items.name: Darth Vader
hints: You can hear me before you see me.
I have a complicated family situation.
I wear a lot of black.

items.name: Batman
hints: I am very rich and very sad.
I work nights.
My city has a signal for me.

items.name: James Bond
hints: I am particular about my drinks.
I have a number.
Several people have played me.

items.name: Gollum
hints: I lost something I loved.
I talk to myself constantly.
I call it precious.

items.name: Serena Williams
hints: I play a sport with a net.
My sister is also very good at it.
I have more than twenty major titles.

items.name: Sachin Tendulkar
hints: I played a sport with a bat for 24 years.
A whole country stopped to watch me.
I have a hundred hundreds.

items.name: Lionel Messi
hints: I am quite short for my job.
I am from Argentina.
I finally won the World Cup.

items.name: Muhammad Ali
hints: I talked as well as I fought.
I changed my name.
Float like a butterfly.

items.name: Usain Bolt
hints: My job takes about ten seconds.
I am from Jamaica.
I celebrate with a pose like a bow.

items.name: MS Dhoni
hints: I kept wickets and captained.
I am known for staying calm.
I finished a World Cup with a six.

items.name: Nelson Mandela
hints: I spent 27 years somewhere I did not choose.
I became president afterwards.
I am from South Africa.

items.name: Rani Lakshmibai
hints: I fought on horseback.
I ruled a princely state.
I refused to give up Jhansi.

items.name: B R Ambedkar
hints: I studied a very great deal.
I helped write a constitution.
I fought caste all my life.

items.name: APJ Abdul Kalam
hints: I worked with rockets.
I later took a much more ceremonial job.
Students loved me.

items.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
hints: I was shorter in legend than in life.
I lost badly in Russia.
I ended up on an island. Twice.

items.name: Joan of Arc
hints: I was a teenager with an army.
I said I heard voices.
France made me a saint eventually.

items.name: Beyonce
hints: I was in a group before I was alone.
I release albums without warning.
My fans are a hive.

items.name: Freddie Mercury
hints: I had a four-octave range.
I fronted a band named after royalty.
I once made a stadium sing back at me.

items.name: Lata Mangeshkar
hints: I sang for other people on screen.
My career lasted seven decades.
They called me the nightingale.

items.name: A R Rahman
hints: I compose more than I sing.
I won an Oscar for a song about a slum.
I am from Chennai.

items.name: Bob Marley
hints: I am from Jamaica.
My music is a genre in itself.
Everything is going to be alright.

items.name: Oprah Winfrey
hints: I ask people questions on television.
I had a very famous book club.
You get a car.

items.name: Charlie Chaplin
hints: I said very little on screen.
I had a distinctive walk and a cane.
My moustache became unfortunate later.

items.name: Alfred Hitchcock
hints: I appear briefly in my own work.
I made people afraid of showers.
They call me the master of suspense.

items.name: Rajinikanth
hints: I have a very particular way with a cigarette.
I was a bus conductor first.
There are jokes about what I can do.

items.name: Amitabh Bachchan
hints: My voice is unmistakable.
I was the angry young man.
I later hosted a quiz show.

items.name: Marilyn Monroe
hints: There is a very famous photograph of a dress.
I changed my name.
I sang happy birthday to a president.

items.name: Steve Jobs
hints: I wore the same outfit constantly.
I was fired from my own company.
I came back and it worked out.

items.name: Elon Musk
hints: I run more than one company.
I post a great deal.
I would like to go to Mars.

items.name: Ratan Tata
hints: I ran a very large Indian group.
I wanted to build a very cheap car.
I was known for being quiet about it.

items.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
hints: I started performing as a small child.
I wrote a great deal very quickly.
There is a film about my rival's jealousy.

items.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
hints: I kept working after a serious problem.
There are nine of my symphonies.
I could not hear my own later work.

items.name: Christopher Columbus
hints: I sailed west expecting somewhere else.
I had three ships.
I was extremely wrong about the size of the Earth.

items.name: Neil Armstrong
hints: I went somewhere very few people have.
I said a famous sentence badly.
I left footprints that are still there.

items.name: Stephen Hawking
hints: I wrote a bestseller almost nobody finished.
I studied very dense objects.
My voice was synthesised.

items.name: Alan Turing
hints: I broke codes during a war.
There is a test named after me.
My country apologised far too late.

items.name: Mother Teresa
hints: I worked in Kolkata.
I wore a white sari with blue edges.
I was made a saint.

items.name: Frodo Baggins
hints: I am short and did not want the job.
I carried something heavy a long way.
My gardener is the real hero.

items.name: Katniss Everdeen
hints: I volunteered for something dangerous.
I am good with a bow.
I became a symbol I did not ask to be.

items.name: Simba
hints: I ran away from home.
I have a complicated uncle.
I eventually went back.

items.name: Santa Claus
hints: I work one night a year.
I have a list.
I get in through the chimney.

items.name: Dracula
hints: I keep unusual hours.
I am from Transylvania.
Garlic is a problem for me.

items.name: Mickey Mouse
hints: My ears are two circles.
I started out on a steamboat.
A very large company is built on me.

items.name: Pikachu
hints: I am yellow.
I only say one word.
I am electric.

items.name: Gautama Buddha
hints: I was a prince first.
I sat under a particular tree.
I taught the middle way.

items.name: Sun Tzu
hints: I wrote a short book about conflict.
Business people quote me constantly.
I said the best victory needs no battle.

items.name: Kalpana Chawla
hints: I left the planet.
I was the first Indian-born woman to do so.
My second flight did not come home.
